passiveEffects.name: Blaze
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When using a move, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. When hitting an enemy with a basic attack or move, a cinder is placed on that enemy. Attacking a cindered enemy a certain number of times will cause the cinder to flare, dealing damage to the enemy. When at half HP or less, critical-hit rate is increased by 10% and basic attack speed is increased by 20% for a short time. When at 50% max HP or below, increases critical-hit rate by 10% and auto attack speed by 20% for 5s (30s CD). When hitting an opposing Pokémon with an auto attack or move, places a cinder on the target for 5s; applies 2 cinders with boosted attacks and moves. When placing a 5th cinder on a target, consumes the cinders, dealing additional damage to the target.

moveEffects.name: Ember
moveEffects.originalDescription: Shoot out a small flame, dealing damage to enemies, leaving them burned and decreasing their Attack for a short time. Shoots a small flame at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target and burning them for 3s (dealing damage 3 times). The Attack and Sp. Atk of the burned target are decreased by 5% for 2s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Blazing Bicycle Kick
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Create a giant ball of flame and kick it toward the designated location. The ball releases a fierce shock wave that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also increases movement speed by 10% (stacks with the Unite Buffs) for 5s when it hits. Becomes unstoppable and kicks up a giant ball of flame, then kicks it toward the location of the designated opposing Pokémon. The ball releases a fierce shock wave upon impact, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, dealing additional missing HP damage to those hit; and increasing movement speed by 10% for 5s when this Unite Move hits. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
